subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should maintainers continue with this narrow provenance-based internal orphan drop rule, or choose https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical repair for the linked stale-reply issue?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same issue but encode different session-repair semantics, and this branch still lacks real embedded-agent proof for the exact drop/preserve split.

options.title: Require proof on this branch
options.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until redacted embedded-agent proof shows internal completion text is dropped while `sessions_send` text is preserved.

options.title: Select the broader repair
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical path if maintainers prefer its broader metadata-aware session repair semantics and proof package.

options.title: Narrow the predicate first
options.body: Ask for a smaller source-tool predicate if all six internal handoff tools should not be removed from repaired prompts when a fresh prompt exists.

recommendation.title: Require proof on this branch
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open but blocked until redacted embedded-agent proof shows internal completion text is dropped while `sessions_send` text is preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued user prompt preservation invariant introduced by PR 65478 and to the Agents ownership listed in CONTRIBUTING.md.
